maddeler.e:
أنسلب (form VII)
# أَنْسَلِبُ (ʔansalibu) /ʔan.sa.li.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# أَنْسَلِبَ (ʔansaliba) /ʔan.sa.li.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
# أَنْسَلِبْ (ʔansalib) /ʔan.sa.lib/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْسَلَبَ (insalaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
